title: Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer

Experience 1.5 to 2 years

Department IT / Information Security

Employment Type Full-Time

Industry Fintech / NBFC

Location Ahmedabad, Gujarat

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer with 1.5 years or more of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, network security, system administration, and security monitoring. The candidate will help maintain a secure and reliable technology environment by implementing security controls, monitoring infrastructure, managing vulnerabilities, and supporting applicable regulatory and audit requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Operations

* Monitor security alerts, system logs, and suspicious activities to identify potential threats.
* Support vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and remediation tracking.
* Help protect sensitive customer information, personally identifiable information (PII), and financial data.
* Support endpoint protection (antivirus/EDR), firewall, and intrusion detection/prevention controls.
* Assist with security incident investigation, documentation, escalation, and root cause analysis.
* Support Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing or transfers.

IT Infrastructure & Network Security

* Administer and monitor servers, operating systems, network devices, and cloud infrastructure.
* Support firewall rules, VPNs, access controls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.
* Perform system hardening, security patching, and operating system updates.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, backups, and security configurations.
* Support cloud security and identity/access management in platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
* Assist with backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity (BCP) activities.

Identity & Access Management

* Manage user access provisioning, modification, and deactivation based on approved requests.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
* Conduct periodic access reviews and identify inactive, excessive, or privileged access.

Security Compliance & Audit

* Support cybersecurity and IT control requirements applicable to an RBI-regulated NBFC.
* Assist with internal/external audits, VAPT, evidence collection, and audit response.
* Maintain asset inventories, access review records, patch reports, incident logs, and security documentation.
* Track audit observations and coordinate timely remediation with relevant teams and vendors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Incident Response

* Monitor events using available SIEM, EDR, firewall, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Escalate critical security incidents and infrastructure issues promptly.
* Prepare periodic reports on vulnerabilities, patch compliance, access reviews, security alerts, and infrastructure health.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, and third-party vendor teams to resolve security issues.

Required Technical Skills

* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and firewall fundamentals.
* Operating Systems: Windows Server and Linux administration.
* Security Tools: Exposure to firewalls, antivirus/EDR, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM platforms.
* Infrastructure: Server administration, patch management, backup solutions, and basic cloud security.
* Security Fundamentals: Vulnerability management, system hardening, access control, incident response, and log analysis.
* Cloud Platforms: Basic knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
* Scripting: Basic Python, PowerShell, or Bash scripting is an advantage.
* Documentation: Ability to maintain technical documentation, security reports, and audit evidence.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum 1.5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, network administration, or information security operations.
* Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Security, or cloud security certifications are preferred, not mandatory.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of confidentiality and secure handling of customer information.
* Ability to coordinate with internal teams, auditors, and external technology vendors.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving security risks.
* Good communication, documentation, and incident reporting skills.

Preferred Certifications  
CompTIA Security+  
Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)  
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely identification, tracking, and remediation of vulnerabilities.
* Security patch compliance across servers and endpoints.
* Timely closure of security audit observations.
* Completion of access reviews and appropriate privileged account controls.
* Timely detection, escalation, and documentation of security incidents.
* Monitoring of backup jobs and participation in recovery tests.
* Adherence to approved security policies and infrastructure hardening standards.

Note: The role supports the organization’s cybersecurity and infrastructure controls in line with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the organization’s risk profile.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

direction, and drive a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and

continuous improvement.

● Architecture & Design: Own the architecture and design of scalable, secure, resilient,

and maintainable enterprise applications and distributed systems.

● Product Engineering: Partner with Product, AI/ML, QA, DevOps, and business teams to

translate product requirements into robust technical solutions and deliverables.

● Cloud & Infrastructure: Drive cloud-native development, preferably on AWS, including

microservices, containerization, serverless computing, infrastructure automation, and

automation, or enterprise AI integration.

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.

  

##### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.
  

##### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.

title: Gift City Branch - Market Operations Lead, Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join JPMorganChase's India GIFT City buildout and lead a front\-line operations team at the center of trade lifecycle delivery. You will manage complex post\-trade processes across multiple markets products, strengthen controls, and drive automation and process improvements. This is a high\-visibility role for an experienced operations leader who can deliver results under pressure, develop talent, and partner effectively across trading, technology, risk, and compliance.  

  

As a Vice President Market Operations based in the GIFT City branch (Ahmedabad), you will lead a highly visible operations function responsible for end\-to\-end post‑trade delivery. You will own service delivery, controls, and regulatory compliance across products including foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, and money markets. Reporting to the India Branch Head of Operations, you will lead a team, drive measurable improvements in efficiency and straight\-through processing, and partner closely with the front office and key control functions to deliver stable, well\-controlled operations.

 **Job responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end post\-trade delivery, including trade capture and validation, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, break management, investigations, and issue resolution.
* Own service performance outcomes, improving accuracy, timeliness, straight\-through processing, and client experience.
* Strengthen the risk and control environment through disciplined control execution, issue management, remediation, and audit readiness.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies, maintaining strong governance, documentation, and operating discipline.
* Lead, coach, and develop the team, ensuring clear accountability, effective coverage, and operational resiliency.
* Partner with sales and trading, technology, risk, compliance, and finance teams to resolve exceptions and deliver change effectively.
* Drive automation and process improvements, including workflow redesign, data quality enhancements, and operational dashboards.
* Provide clear reporting on key performance indicators, incidents, control issues, and change delivery progress.

 **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 15 years of experience in markets operations, post\-trade, middle office, or trade support, with end\-to\-end lifecycle ownership across at least one of: foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, or money markets.
* Proven people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and building a strong controls culture.
* Strong knowledge of post\-trade processes, including confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, and investigations.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements, such as reduced breaks, faster turnaround times, higher straight\-through processing, or automation benefits.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use data and key performance indicators to manage performance and prioritize risk.  
* 

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience working in a regulated markets environment, with familiarity with India and emerging markets operating considerations.
* Experience leading change or transformation initiatives in operations in partnership with technology teams.
* Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI\-enabled analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to improve operational efficiency and accuracy, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, well\-controlled execution through coaching, change adoption, and continuous improvement
